description.value: Sushi Town is a Japanese restaurant on the Barnet Highway corridor in Coquitlam offering traditional sushi, sashimi, specialty rolls, teriyaki, udon, and tempura dishes. The restaurant provides both dine-in service with table reservations and online delivery across multiple distance zones. Touring cyclists passing through Coquitlam on Barnet Highway will find a full sit-down Japanese meal available here.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at sushitown.ca is active and confirms the OSM address (2773 Barnet Hwy, Coquitlam, BC V3B 1C2) and phone number (604 552 6156). The site confirms online ordering, delivery, and table reservations but makes no mention of bike parking, racks, washrooms, or any cyclist-specific amenities. The front page and subpages show differing business hours listings, suggesting the site may not be fully maintained.
concerns: Business hours listed on the front page differ from those shown on menu and promotion subpages, suggesting the website content may not be consistently maintained.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating Japanese restaurant on a main highway corridor with an active website confirming address, phone, and services.
